image_manifest.description: A celebratory 3D rendered asset manifest showing the outcome of a weight comparison game with two pterosaurs of vastly different sizes on a beach seesaw.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Red text with a yellow 3D border reading 'Weigh The Pterosaur!' centered at the top of the frame, matching the previous card's typography.

assets.name: Victory Text
assets.description: Bold, celebratory red 3D text reading 'Player Wins!' centered at the bottom of the frame.

assets.name: Hatzegopteryx (Heavy Character)
assets.description: A massive, robust Hatzegopteryx with a thick neck and mottled orange-brown skin. It is seated firmly on the right end of the seesaw, which is pressed deep into the sand, indicating its immense weight.

assets.name: Nemicolopterus (Light Character)
assets.description: A tiny, sparrow-sized Nemicolopterus with bright green and yellow markings. It is positioned on the left end of the seesaw, which is tilted high toward the sky, causing the small creature to look down with a surprised, wide-eyed expression.

assets.name: Wooden Seesaw Item
assets.description: The same wooden plank and log pivot from the previous scene, now at a steep diagonal angle with the right side touching the ground.

assets.name: Solnhofen Beach Environment
assets.description: The tropical lagoon environment from the Solnhofen formation, featuring fine white sand, a turquoise sea, and a distant limestone cliff under a bright, clear sky.

assets.name: Visual Effects
assets.description: A small dust cloud kicked up where the heavy end of the seesaw hit the sand, and bright, celebratory sun glints reflecting off the water.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.
